summary: Whether you show it or not, deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and a longing for something more and a soft, porous edge are fused in you - you can't run one without the other. At your best, you read people and care on instinct and you imagine, feel for others, and create. At the edge, your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need.

Strong for imaginative work; protect boundaries and energy. Care may feel porous here. Emotional safety can be tied to sensitivity, imagination, and the need to feel understood without explaining everything.
gift: At your best: you read people and care on instinct, and you imagine, feel for others, and create.
shadow: The trap: your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need - or you escape, idealize, or lose your own outline.
integration: Let emotional needs and imagination and longing cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Strong for imaginative work; protect boundaries and energy.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you read people and you imagine, feel for others, work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
